variations.title_hi: जीवन रेखा के भीतर, मंगल से
variations.title_en: From inside the life line, on Mars
variations.reading_hi: Mastishk rekha jeevan rekha ke andar se shuru hoti hai — ati-samvedansheel aur jaldi excite hone wala swabhav. Chhoti baatein dil par lag jaati hain. Apni is teevra oorja ko disha dena hi aapki asli jeet hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate I position 1, pp.14-15

drawing.note: The head line begins inside the life line, on Mars: its start sits at the wrist-side edge of the head corridor, below the life line's start (the life line drawn on the thumb side of its corridor), then joins the usual course. lines.ts:702-713 reads this as inside_life_line (separation >= 0.08, below the life start).

variations.title_hi: आरंभ में जीवन रेखा से जुड़ी
variations.title_en: Joined to the life line at the start
variations.reading_hi: Mastishk rekha jeevan rekha se judi hui hai — gehri samvedansheelta aur savdhaani ka sanket. Aap apni pratibha ko kam aankte hain. Sach yeh hai ki aap jitna sochte hain usse kahin zyada capable hain.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate I position 2, p.16

drawing.note: The head and life lines start together: the head runs along the finger-side edge of its corridor, which puts its start on the life line's start (separation under 0.03); the heart line (context) sits high, clear of it.

variations.title_en: Slightly apart from the life line
variations.reading_hi: Mastishk rekha jeevan rekha se thodi alag shuru hoti hai — utkrisht sanket. Swatantra soch, turant nirnay aur mansik saahas aapko bheed se alag karta hai. Aap flash mein woh samajh lete hain jo doosre mehnat se seekhte hain.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate I position 3, pp.19-21

drawing.note: Slightly apart from the life line: the head's own start knot, and the life line starting a little toward the thumb — lines.ts's separated_narrow band (0.03-0.08).

variations.title_en: Widely apart from the life line
variations.reading_hi: Rekhaon ke beech zyada doori — bejhijhak, impulsive aur suriyon mein rehne ki chaah. Himmat kamaal ki hai, lekin plans baar-baar badalna aapki pragati rok sakta hai. Ek cheez pakdo, poora karo.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate III position 4, pp.21-22

drawing.note: Widely apart: the head starts high at the top of its corridor, and the life line begins lower down (from 0.14 of its corridor), leaving a clear space between them above the life start.

variations.title_hi: चंद्र पर्वत की ओर हल्की ढलान
variations.reading_hi: Mastishk rekha halki si Chandra parvat ki or dhalti hai — kalpana par aapka niyantran hai. Aap imagination ko tool ki tarah use karte hain, uske gulaam nahi bante. Creative professionals ka aadarsh sanket.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate II position 1, p.18

drawing.note: The canonical head line: it falls 0.12 from start to end, lines.ts's gentle_slope_luna band (0.06-0.16).

variations.reading_hi: Rekha gehri Chandra parvat mein utarti hai — kalpana ki duniya aap par haavi ho sakti hai. Mood ke hisaab se kaam hota hai aur mann kabhi-kabhi bhaari ho jaata hai. Routine, dhoop aur apne logon ka saath aapke liye dawa hai; mann zyada bojhal lage toh kisi apne se ya professional se baat karna samajhdari hai.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate II position 4, pp.18-19 (softened per safety policy)

drawing.note: The line drifts steadily down across its corridor to end at the wrist-side edge, toward the Moon: a fall over 0.16 (deep_slope_luna).

variations.title_hi: बुध पर्वत की ओर ऊपर मुड़ती
variations.reading_hi: Mastishk rekha ant mein Budh parvat ki or upar uthti hai — umra ke saath dhan kamane ki ichchha aur usko paane ka sankalp dono badhte jayenge. Business-mind aapke andar samay ke saath aur tez hoga.

sources.loc: Ch.II, Plate V position 4, p.28

drawing.note: Starts low and turns up at the end toward Mercury: the end sits at the finger-side edge of the corridor, higher than the start (a drop below -0.04).

variations.reading_hi: Jupiter strong + Head line lambi aur saaf — Cheiro kehta hai isse behtar koi mount nahi hai. Aapki success kismat se nahi, character aur purpose ki taqat se aayegi. Ek bada lakshya chuno aur usse chipak jao — baaki sab follow karega. Inner Mars strong + Head line clear = sanyam wala yoddha. Cheiro ke mutabik aise log life mein kisi bhi unchaai tak ja sakte hain aur doosron ke liye bada kaam karte hain. Aapka asli hathiyaar himmat nahi, self-control hai — usse roz sharpen karo. Mercury strong + Head line lambi aur saaf = mental aptitude ka best combo. Cheiro kehta hai yeh success ka promise badha deta hai — business, science, law, media, tech, kahin bhi. Aapke paas raw speed bhi hai aur steering bhi; ab bas destination chuno. Jupiter Negative + clear, strong Head line = sensitivity ko will power se jeetne ki capacity. Cheiro kehta hai yahi line tay karti hai ki aapke talents bahar aayenge ya nahi — aur aapke paas hai. Ab bas consistently dikhna shuru karo. Mercury Negative + clear seedhi Head line — Cheiro kehta hai mushkil waqt mein aapki best qualities khud aapko bachane aati hain: practicality, consistency, clear thinking. Aap crisis mein bikharte nahi, organise karte ho. Bhagya rekha halki hai lekin mastishk rekha zabardast — aap kismat ko maanne walon mein se nahi hain, aur aapko zaroorat bhi nahi. Aapki safalta shudh roop se aapke dimaag ki den hogi. Destiny aapke liye likhi nahi gayi; aap use roz likhte hain. Mars Negative window + clear Head line — Cheiro ke shabdon mein 'mental endeavour ki duniya mein koi cheez nahi jisme aap safal na ho sako'. Field chunne ki tension mat lo; jo bhi chuno, usme top tak ja sakte ho.

variations.reading_hi: Inner Mars strong par Head line kamzor — impulsiveness ko brake nahi mil rahi. Cheiro warn karta hai ki aise log bina soche mushkilon mein kood jaate hain aur apni leadership ka mauka gawa dete hain. Aapke liye planning system (pehle likho, phir karo) luxury nahi, zaroorat hai. Jupiter bada hai par Head line kamzor — ambition ko direction nahi mil rahi, isliye woh pride aur vanity ban jaati hai. Fix simple hai: 'main sahi hoon' bolne se pehle 'kya main sahi hoon?' poochna — roz. Yahi aapka growth hack hai. Mercury bada par Head line kamzor — tez dimaag ko steering nahi mil rahi: bechaini, focus ki kami, aur business mein shortcut lene ka lalach. Do rules apnao: ek waqt mein ek kaam, aur jo deal 'too clever' lage usse chhod do. Cleverness se lamba reputation chalta hai, shortcuts se nahi. Mercury Negative par Head line kamzor — aapki natural consistency ko support nahi mil rahi, isliye self-reference aur mood-driven faisle haavi ho sakte hain. Structure bahar se lao: accountability partner, likhit goals, weekly review. System aapki will power ka backup hai.

variations.reading_hi: Jab headline mount of Moon ki taraf unequal branches phenke, toh yeh mental restlessness ya scattered thinking ka ek ruchaan hai. Yeh sthayi nahi hai — vyakti apni mental energy ko focus karne par kaam kar sakta hai. Equal aur sooth branches bilkul opposite indicate karte hain — clear aur well-composed thinking.
